headline.text: L1 Sollich 2 lost *5 hours* dialing in Cavanna wrappers on new caramel product — back at target rate by 18:17.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 ran CPK caramel for Mexico with extended Cavanna wrapper tuning from 13:47 to 18:17, then hit 5.5 pallets per hour. Sollich 3 completed allergen sanitation for next product; two pieces still need Monday follow-up.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 completed Level 2 clean by 08:00 except for north Sweco — torn screen and embedded debris will need replacement Monday morning to avoid delaying temper unit 2 startup. Shutdown checklist not followed overnight; both compressors found off.

notes.text: Warehouse located 28 international Peco pallets for CPK Mexico order; 15 more found overnight.
Internet down at plant as of 08:03.

resolved.title: Cavanna 3 and 4 jaws misaligned, wrap bunching on CPK caramel startup
resolved.summary: Both wrappers had film positioning and jaw height issues causing incomplete seals and bunched wrap; line paused 13:47 for extended troubleshooting with maintenance.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 18:17 — Caleb adjusted film roll positions and jaw height on both machines; line restarted and "running smoothly" with fresh product by 18:47.

resolved.title: Decorator and target depositor failed allergen swab on Sollich 3
resolved.summary: Initial allergen failures on decorator (4 swabs) and target depositor during post-production sanitation verification.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:58 — "able to pass the decorator and the target depositor" after additional cleaning (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: L1 out of heavy-duty paper towels during sanitation
resolved.summary: No cleaning towels available mid-shift for sanitation crew.
resolved.resolution: Resolved by 17:47 — warehouse had stock in cage and Jose retrieved more from L2 (Estarli Ermisz).

resolved.title: Depositor 2 mixer shaft broken on ML4
resolved.summary: Mixer component fractured at mounting point during Level 2 clean.
resolved.resolution: Resolved by 19:46 — "Robert exchanged it for another one from this depositor" (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: Mold jam in cooling cabinet 2 during post-clean cycle test
resolved.summary: Single mold jammed while cycling molds through cooler after ML4 Level 2 clean.
resolved.resolution: Cleared immediately — "Once that was cleared, we cycled about 25 to 30 molds and had no other issues" (Tyson Fausett, 07:49).

needs_attention.title: Z belt in pack area failed allergen swab 2X on Sollich 3
needs_attention.summary: Conveyor passed sanitation visually but failed ATP allergen test twice; not needed for next product so deferred to Monday reclean.
needs_attention.status: Still open as of 15:58; reclean scheduled Monday with QA supervisor sign-off needed.

needs_attention.title: Inclusion belt and hopper failed allergen swab on Sollich 3
needs_attention.summary: Victor flagged allergen failure at 21:50; suspected insufficient rinse based on past similar issues.
needs_attention.status: Re-soaping and rinsing started at 22:04; no pass confirmation posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Break room card reader dead, no power
needs_attention.summary: Electronic badge reader on break room door has no light and will not unlock.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 06:37; Benjamin suggested maintenance or checking for loose wire, no update posted.

needs_attention.title: North Sweco screen torn with embedded debris on ML4
needs_attention.summary: Screen passed ATP but has visible tear and hard black chunks that won't come out; concern over contamination risk if reinstalled.
needs_attention.status: Sweco cleaned and covered, power turned off at 06:23 to prevent use. Replacement screen needed Monday morning before temper unit 2 can start; warehouse located spares but crew unable to retrieve and clean by shift end.

needs_attention.title: Both ML4 compressors found off, shutdown checklist not followed
needs_attention.summary: Tyson arrived to both compressors off (one appeared off for extended time); WDS not in night mode, heater left on, FSC on chiller still running.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 23:58; no resolution update by window close.

needs_attention.title: Internet down at L3 plant
needs_attention.status: Reported at 08:03; no resolution or ETA posted.

needs_attention.title: Cooling cabinet 3 upper floor has new bubble in surface
needs_attention.summary: QA noticed bubble in middle of upper cooling floor that neither she nor Tyson recall seeing in prior inspections.
needs_attention.status: Flagged to Chad and Rose at 04:34; no assessment or action posted.
